text:
Alex (Finance): Heads-up — got a reseller statement from our GCP partner that doesn't match our internal committed usage credits for Feb. ~USD 42,317 short on the payout side. Can infra ops look into whether usage was misattributed to the wrong project or commitment?
Maria (Infra): thanks, linking the statement now. do you have invoice id?
Alex (Finance): invoice GCP-RS-20260228-1192, reseller CSV attached in the upload channel. Summary shows: reseller_credit=125,480; our ledger expected_credit=167,797.
Sam (Ops): pinging infra infra-sre — could be committed use discount (CUD) vs marketplace SKU mapping. quick check: did we move some fleets to a private VPC project last month? that can change marketplace attribution.
Maria (Infra): we did shift a subset of dedicated GPUs to project redwood-dedicated-prod-vpc on 2026-02-14 for the Private rollout. I'll grep billing tags.
Jess (Sales): FYI reseller said they applied reseller discount adjustments for 'partner-bundle' SKUs — might get lumped differently. I can ask them for a breakpoint report. @billing-bot can you pull the marketplace line items for that invoice?
billing-bot: Requested: pulling GCP marketplace line items for invoice GCP-RS-20260228-1192. Returning CSV snippet: 
```
sku,project,usage_amount,charge
NVIDIA_T4_1hr,redwood-prod,1200,18000
NVIDIA_A10_1hr,redwood-dedicated,600,54000
RES_GCP_COMMIT_CREDIT,redwood-prod,,-125480
```
Maria (Infra): hmm the commit credit row is attached to redwood-prod only. our committed capacity is split across redwood-prod and redwood-dedicated. suspect the reseller only applied credits to one project.
Sam (Ops): can we confirm which commitment IDs the reseller is associating? run: `gcloud beta billing accounts transactions list --filter="invoiceId:GCP-RS-20260228-1192" --format=json` should show commitment references.
Alex (Finance): reseller rep told me earlier they mapped credits to the "primary account" which is redwood-prod, not the dedicated project. But the commitment contract (Reseller-Commit-2025-Q4) covers both. That's the mismatch.
Maria (Infra): quick internal audit: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28 usage shows 1,800 GPU hours on dedicated pool that we expected to be covered by the reseller commitment. If credits only hit one project, that explains the ~42k delta.
Jess (Sales): I'll escalate to the reseller AM for reallocation. Requesting an itemized re-apply to project-level SKUs. Also need a corrected statement PDF and an explicit mapping of commitment IDs to projects.
Sam (Ops): operationally, we should add a guard: ensure future reseller credit allocations include a cost-allocation tag like `reseller_committment_id` on affected projects. I'll add a ticket to infra backlog to enforce tag propagation at provisioning.
Alex (Finance): action items: (1) Jess to get reseller to reissue statement and reapply credits by project (2) Maria to confirm usage split & produce a one-page reconciliation CSV (3) Sam to add tagging + short policy. I'll hold the Feb payout reconciliation until we get the corrected statement.
Maria (Infra): uploading reconciliation CSV to the thread in 10m. includes hourly export and project mapping.
Jess (Sales): Reseller AM replied: they accepted the reapply request and will send corrected statement in 48-72h. added note: they may apply manual credit adjustments which can take one billing cycle. :thumbsup:
Alex (Finance): thanks. please @me when corrected PDF lands. also file a short postmortem with the topline root cause + mitigation.
Sam (Ops): created infra ticket INF-1042: ensure `reseller_commitment_id` tag is applied at pool creation + verification job nightly.
Maria (Infra): done — reconciliation CSV uploaded. short sample (first 3 rows):
```
2026-02-01T00:00Z,redwood-dedicated,NVIDIA_A10,24h,36
2026-02-01T00:00Z,redwood-prod,NVIDIA_T4,24h,48
2026-02-01T01:00Z,redwood-dedicated,NVIDIA_A10,1h,1
```
billing-bot: Noted. I'll attach the reconciliation CSV to the finance ledger ticket FIN-889 and mark the invoice as "under review".
Alex (Finance): good thread. keeping this open until corrected statement posted.
Jess (Sales): reseller just DM'd: possible root cause was a webhook mapping bug in their marketplace integration — credits only flowed to the account-level line items. they will patch and backfill.
Maria (Infra): let's assume a 1-cycle delay. we should model the cost impact in next week's CFO report so forecast isn't off by ~42k.
Alex (Finance): agreed — I'll include a note. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
